final: WITH q AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) AS qty FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(product_quantity) <> ''), b AS (SELECT AVG(qty) AS baseline FROM q), o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM q GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ids.order_id AS order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM Order_Items) ids LEFT JOIN o ON o.order_id = ids.order_id CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_baseline DESC, ids.order_id LIMIT 10
